thread:
mika: Planning a lean-root rebake + signer rotation next Monday 08:00 PT. Scope: drop deprecated libs, rotate cosign key in KMS, and confirm audit linkage imageSHA -> SBOM -> signature. Need quick RBAC/KMS preflight.

bern: Prefer incremental canaries (4 cohorts) and automated verification after each wave. Will need RBAC for signer + publicKeyViewer for ops verifier.

soph: Minimal IAM change (GCP style) I propose: 
```
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> serviceAccount:runtime-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer -> serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Also ensure attestor flow has logging/audit permissions (auditlog:write).

mika: Thanks. Can you drop that as a terraform MR? We'll fast-track after review.

soph: MR created: https://git.internal/infra/mr/7682 includes tf diff, acceptance test plan, and rollback steps.

build-bot: CI scan results for candidate image: brotli packagediff detected (allowlist drift). Link: https://ci.internal/scan/17988 (warning).

bern: I'll triage brotli right now. If it's just semver bump with no CVE, mark non-blocker after SBOM diff review.

ops: Ops wants a sample audit event shape so telemetry can accept the new pairing. Suggested minimal payload: 
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:deadbeef...",
  "sbom_uri": "gs://sboms/sha256-deadbeef.json",
  "signature_ref": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/cosign/signatures/abcd1234",
  "key_version": "3",
  "promoted_by": "serviceAccount:ci-deployer",
  "timestamp": "2026-01-12T15:00:00Z"
}
```

mika: Good. Add attestor_id and keyRing metadata so forensic mapping is straightforward.

ops: Updated example payload posted to ops repo.

bern: Quick vuln triage update: brotli shows a minor patch bump, no NVD CVEs and internal DB clean. Non-blocker. Uploading SBOM diff link to MR.

soph: Noted. Small infra ask: when we rotate keys, keep old key publicKeyViewer for 48h so verification of older signatures still works. We'll retire after the monitoring window.

mika: Agreed. Keeper: retain public key for 48h verification-only, then remove Sign but keep Viewer until 7 days for forensic.

pager: Rollback playbook (short): if canary failure >3% error rate OR verification mismatch, revert tag and redeploy previous digest. Snippets: 
```
# revert registry tag to previous sha
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy previous digest (prefer explicit digest)
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha -n runtime || kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n runtime
```
Also: page SRE if metrics spike >threshold or cosign verify fails.

mika: We'll embed that into the runbook and attach the canary watch checklist. Ops: please add monitoring alerts for signature-verification-failure and SBOM-mismatch.

ops: Added alerts: `signature.verify.fail` and `sbom.mismatch.count` to the runtime SLO dashboard. Pager will be on call during the window.

bern: One more safety check : ensure prefix/KV caches that store image metadata are invalidated post-rollout. If old metadata persists we could serve stale SBOM links. Devon had a script for that, can somebody re-run it during promotion?

soph: I'll add an automated cache invalidation job in the deploy pipeline that runs after promotion and before tag move. Snippet in MR.

mika: Action list: 1) @soph merge IAM MR after two approvals, 2) @bern attach SBOM diff & triage note (done), 3) @ops add the sample audit shape to telemetry (done), 4) @pager ensure runbook rollback snippet & watch (done), 5) @mika publish runbook link to calendar invite. Canary schedule: Mon 08:00 PT, waves: 5% (20m) -> 20% (30m) -> 40% (30m) -> 100% ramp.

soph: MR approved by infra + security leads. Will merge once CI passes.

build-bot: CI post-signing check `sbom-verify` will assert signature metadata logged to audit service. Failing that blocks promotion.

mika: Perfect. If everything looks green we'll proceed Monday. If any of the checks fail we'll kick the incident runbook and roll back. Thanks team.
